notes: TitheDemo is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 TDEMO once to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. Transfers deliver the exact amount, with no transfer tax or burn. There are no external minting, burning, or administrative entry points and no application contracts. The pool initialPrice is provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
